messages:
Alex (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock the backward-compat approach for v1 -> v2 before the next release. Major asks: tool/function-calling semantics, structured output keys, and embeddings shape. Who can summarise the must-have compat exceptions?
Maria (SRE): From infra POV, fallback routes are cheap to keep for 6 months. We should only force-terminate v1 when traffic <5% or after opt-in migration window. :+1:
Devin (Eng): Agree on fallback. For tool calling the tricky part is callback shape changes. Proposal: add a compatibility header `x-rw-compat: v1` we honor for a deprecation window and translate v2 -> v1 payloads on the edge.
Jess (CS): We got 3 enterprise customers asking to keep v1 tool.cb param exact for audit hooks. They won't move unless we provide a migration shim or a short-term webhook adapter.
Sam (SE): Suggest we define launch criteria: 1) v2 contract doc published, 2) migration guide with examples, 3) shim available for function calling, 4) one live-customer migration tested. If any of these fail, we hold.
Alex (PM): Good checklist. Need estimated effort for the shim (edge translation) and for docs. Devin, Maria — how much dev + infra work?
Devin (Eng): Rough numbers: shim prototype 2 dev-weeks (edge service), tests + automation 1 dev-week, integration with routing 3d. Total ~3.5 weeks of engineering.
Maria (SRE): Infra: small instance for shim in prod (canary + autoscale) and observability hooks. Ops support ~1 week to run canary and metrics. We'll need a feature flag.
Jess (CS): Can we offer a temporary opt-in toggle for customers to keep v1 behavior per-org? That buys migration time and reduces churn.
Devin (Eng): Yes — implement as per-API-key flag. Implementation: flag checked in gateway before routing to runtime. Pseudocode:
```
if api_key.has_flag("compat_v1"):
  route = "v1-shim"
else:
  route = "v2"
```
Sam (SE): About embeddings: v2 returns `embedding` array of floats; v1 used `vector`. We should support both keys for 3 months and add a lint rule in SDKs to prefer `embedding`.
Alex (PM): Timeline proposal: publish contract + docs next Tue, shim + canary by end of month, 3-month maintenance window after GA for compat keys, then announce deprecation 30d before enforced removal. Thoughts?
Maria (SRE): Sounds reasonable. Add SLA delta: during maintenance window we do not guarantee old-key latency SLAs. Call that out to customers.
Jess (CS): I'll draft comms and migration checklist for customers — include sample webhook adapter code and a checklist for function-calling changes.
Devin (Eng): I'll scope the shim ticket and break it into subtasks (gateway flag, translator module, tests). Will tag eng-runtime and eng-platform.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: canary/shim-service to prod at 2025-11-14T13:30:00Z
Alex (PM): Thanks team. Action items: Devin ticket by EOD, Jess migration doc draft by Wednesday, Maria to schedule canary. We'll reconvene Thursday for go/no-go. :calendar:
